name: Tidewell
tagline: The operating system for modern cold-plunge studios.
positioning: Tidewell helps owner-operators run bookings, water-quality logs, and memberships from one calm dashboard built for cold-therapy studios.

hero.h1: Run your plunge studio with a clear, steady hand.
hero.sub: Tidewell brings scheduling, water-quality logs, waivers, and memberships into one place — so you can spend your mornings coaching, not chasing spreadsheets.

features.title: Session booking that fits plunge slots
features.description: Sell 15-minute plunge windows, sauna add-ons, and contrast sessions with per-tub capacity limits and buffer time built right in.

features.title: Water-quality logbook
features.description: Record temperature, pH, ORP, and chlorine readings by tub, get overdue-check reminders, and export a clean compliance history on demand.

features.title: Memberships and packs
features.description: Sell monthly unlimited plans or 10-plunge packs, auto-bill on file, and pause memberships when someone travels — no spreadsheet gymnastics.

features.title: Digital waivers
features.description: Every first-timer signs your liability and health-screening waiver on their phone before they hit the water, stored against their profile forever.

features.title: Staff seats and roles
features.description: Give front-desk and coaches their own logins with the right permissions, so refunds and settings stay with the owners.

features.title: Studio dashboard
features.description: See today's bookings, no-shows, revenue, and overdue water checks the moment you open the door each morning.

testimonials.quote: Before Tidewell I tracked pH readings on a clipboard and bookings on a text thread. Now the whole studio runs from one screen and I actually take a day off.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The water-quality log alone paid for it. When the health inspector asked for six months of readings, I exported them in about ten seconds.
testimonials.name: Danny Okafor

testimonials.quote: Memberships and packs used to leak revenue everywhere. Auto-billing and pack tracking recovered a couple thousand dollars in my first quarter.
testimonials.name: Hannah Brecht

pricing.blurb: For a single-location studio getting off the clipboard.
For growing studios with a front desk and coaching team.

homepage.footerBlurb: Tidewell is the quiet operating system behind independent cold-plunge and recovery studios. Built for owner-operators who'd rather coach than reconcile.
